notes: Read all 4 numbered source lines before editing. The source is a re-export barrel: L1 export {StatusHeader} from './StatusHeader', L2 export {EntriesTable} from './EntriesTable', L3 export {AuditPanel} from './AuditPanel', L4 export {EntryDrawer} from './EntryDrawer'. Every line is a re-export of one sibling component; all four are reproduced and surfaced under the exact same public names by the native index.ts.

Ordering constraint: this barrel is converted BEFORE its four sibling components, and none of StatusHeader/EntriesTable/AuditPanel/EntryDrawer exist under web-parity yet (verified by grep — no matches in apps/native/src). The native tsconfig type-checks the whole tree (include **/*.ts,**/*.tsx), and baseline typecheck/lint/test are all green, so a barrel re-exporting not-yet-ported './StatusHeader' etc. would fail typecheck. JSX is also illegal in a .ts file, so the required output index.ts MUST stay a JSX-free re-export barrel. The four native ports therefore live in one co-located ./DlqInspectorPanels.tsx module and index.ts re-exports {StatusHeader, EntriesTable, AuditPanel, EntryDrawer} from it — identical public API to the web barrel, with the four implementations centralised in one file to avoid duplicating the shared helpers/primitives across four files (DRY).

StatusHeader (web StatusHeader.tsx) ported faithfully: count = data?.count ?? 0, replayable = (data?.entries ?? []).filter(e => e.replayable).length, enabled = data?.replay_enabled ?? false. The three StatCards become shared native MetricCards with value '—' while loading then fmtInt(count)/fmtInt(replayable)/(enabled ? Enabled : Disabled); i18n keys admin.dlq.stats.total/totalSub/replayable/replayableSub/replayMode/enabled/disabled/replayModeSub preserved verbatim with English defaults. The !loading && !enabled AlertBanner(variant=warning) becomes a native warning banner with admin.dlq.banners.disabledTitle/disabledMessage verbatim (including the result="disabled" text). The decorative lucide Inbox/ShieldCheck/AlertOctagon icons are dropped (MetricCard has no icon slot).

EntriesTable (web EntriesTable.tsx) ported faithfully: useSortToggle('arrived_at','desc') reproduced (same key → toggle dir, new key → asc), the [...rows].sort comparator switch (arrived_at via Date.parse, parsed_reason/parsed_vin via localeCompare with ?? '' guard, raw_payload_size numeric, default 0) copied verbatim, and formatBytes copied verbatim. The DataTable becomes a sortable chip bar (the four sortable columns arrived_at/parsed_reason/parsed_vin/raw_payload_size with ▲/▼ on the active column) over a scrollable single-column card list — every column is rendered (arrived/reason/vin/source topic/redeliveries/payload/replayable Badge/Inspect Button). row.parsed_redeliveries !== null (type is number|null, equivalent to web != null) guards fmtInt; replayable → success/neutral Badge with common.yes/common.no; Inspect → onInspect(row). Empty/loading text uses admin.dlq.table.loading 'Loading…' and admin.dlq.table.empty 'No DLQ entries — the pipeline is clean.' verbatim; all admin.dlq.cols.* and admin.dlq.actions.inspect keys preserved.

AuditPanel (web AuditPanel.tsx) ported faithfully: RESULT_VARIANT map (ok→success, publish_failed→danger, rate_limited→warning, disabled→warning, not_found→neutral, unparseable→danger) copied verbatim; the !loading && rows.length === 0 early return renders the shared native EmptyState with the scoped vs global message (admin.dlq.audit.empty.title/scopedMessage/globalMessage), otherwise a card list rendering replayed_at/actor/dlq_id/result Badge/dst_topic/error/trace_id with the same '—' fallbacks and admin.dlq.audit.cols.* headers. The loading-with-no-rows path shows admin.dlq.audit.loading 'Loading audit log…' verbatim, matching the web DataTable emptyMessage.

EntryDrawer (web EntryDrawer.tsx) ported faithfully: state name activeTab (default 'inner'), innerText/rawText useMemo over decodeBase64Utf8(full.inner_payload_b64/raw_payload_b64), head = full ?? summary, tabs [inner,raw], and replayDisabled = !replayEnabled || !head?.replayable || replayInFlight || loading — all preserved. decodeBase64Utf8 reproduces atob + TextDecoder('utf-8',{fatal:true}) via a pure-JS base64 decoder + strict UTF-8 decoder that returns '' on any invalid sequence, so binary protobuf bodies fall through to the admin.dlq.drawer.binaryPayload/binaryEnvelope '{{n}} bytes' markers (n = inner_payload_size/raw_payload_size) exactly as on web. Drawer → RN Modal slide-in; KVList → labelled native fields (id/arrived/dlqTopic/reason/vin/sourceTopic/redeliveries/parseError); Tabs → native tab bar; the <pre> base64 viewer → a maxHeight 320 ScrollView with selectable monospace AppText; CopyButton text uses innerText||full?.inner_payload_b64||'' (and raw equivalent) verbatim. Footer Close + Replay buttons preserved; the lucide Send icon becomes a ➤ glyph; admin.dlq.drawer.* + common.close keys preserved.

Native-safe adaptations: react-i18next is not wired in native, so a local useT() fallback returns the supplied English default (or the key) and applies {{var}} interpolation, preserving every i18n key verbatim. fmtInt reproduces web fmtNumber(v,0) (safeNumber→0, rounded, en-US grouping) without Intl. <TimeStamp format="absolute"> becomes a native absolute formatter returning '—' for null/invalid (tooltip/relative/locale/timezone settings are not wired on native yet). The web CopyButton's navigator.clipboard.writeText becomes a native-safe writeClipboard that uses navigator.clipboard when present (react-native-web) and reports an explicit 'Unavailable' state on iOS/Android where no clipboard module is bundled, never flipping to 'Copied' on failure. The @/types/admin-diagnostics DLQ types are inlined (native types module does not exist yet). No DOM, Recharts, Leaflet, lucide-react, or old web ui components are imported — only RN primitives (View/ScrollView/Pressable/Modal/ActivityIndicator/StyleSheet/Platform) and the shared native GlassPanel/MetricCard/EmptyState/AppText against theme tokens.
